credit_cards.waiver: Spend-based annual fee reversal on request: call HBL Contact Centre 111-111-425 or email customer.care@hbl.com. Spend must be met within 60 days of the statement generation date in which the annual fee is levied. Existing HBL account holders must have a Direct Debit Instruction (minimum or full payment) to qualify; not required for New-to-Bank customers. Waiver is discretionary (HBL may withdraw or change criteria).

Spend-based annual fee reversal on request: call HBL Contact Centre 111-111-425 or email customer.care@hbl.com. Spend must be met within 60 days of the statement generation date in which the annual fee is levied. Existing HBL account holders must have a Direct Debit Instruction (minimum or full payment) to qualify; not required for New-to-Bank customers. Waiver is discretionary (HBL may withdraw or change criteria).

Spend-based annual fee reversal on request: call HBL Contact Centre 111-111-425 or email customer.care@hbl.com. Spend must be met within 60 days of the statement generation date in which the annual fee is levied. Existing HBL account holders must have a Direct Debit Instruction (minimum or full payment) to qualify; not required for New-to-Bank customers. Waiver is discretionary (HBL may withdraw or change criteria). Also: HBL Prestige members get 50% annual fee waiver (SOBC Part T).
